pictures.name: JAY1-The-Fruit
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A lush, glowing garden of paradise: rivers, flowering trees, and in the middle one great ancient tree heavy with golden, unnamed fruit. Beneath it, the first man and woman, small and far away as soft silhouettes in garden light, seen only from behind with no faces visible, fully and modestly clothed in long simple garments of woven leaves, one reaching up toward a low branch. Warm gold light pouring through leaves, deep blue shadows, beauty and tension.

pictures.name: JAY4-The-Cell
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A stone prison cell in Saint Petersburg in 1798, a small barred window with pale winter light. Rabbi Shneur Zalman, an elderly Hasidic teacher with a long white beard, in a white robe and a black coat, sits calmly on a wooden bench. Before him stands a Russian prison official in a dark green uniform with brass buttons, a thoughtful middle-aged man, holding a lantern, asking a question with a curious frown. Warm lantern gold, deep blue shadows.
